title: Minnesota lawyer suspended over fake AI case citations

reading.body:
The underlying article text was not available for processing, so the only established fact here is that a Minnesota lawyer was suspended in connection with fake AI case citations, as reported by a single outlet. The specific AI system involved, the court or courts affected, the number of fabricated citations, and the procedural details of the suspension are not established by the provided material.

What the title does indicate is a pattern documented elsewhere: a generative AI system producing plausible but nonexistent legal citations, which a lawyer then submitted in a legal proceeding without independently verifying them against authoritative sources. This is a deployment failure at the human review stage, not solely a model failure, because the output entered an official proceeding without a check that would have caught the fabrication.

Whether the lawyer acted negligently or intentionally, and what the precise disciplinary findings were, is not established by the available information.
